themes.title: Bitcoin breaks below $70,000
themes.summary: Bitcoin fell through $70,000 Thursday night and dipped below its 200-week moving average near $68,000, reaching its lowest level since mid-August before a partial rebound Friday morning (KuCoin News; Yahoo Finance).

themes.title: Rate-hike bets and a strong dollar
themes.summary: Traders priced in about an 88% chance of a quarter-point Fed hike in December, the 10-year Treasury yield was near 5.15% and the U.S. Dollar Index held above 103, near a 19-month high (KuCoin News).

themes.title: Heavy liquidations
themes.summary: About $1.3 billion to $1.64 billion of leveraged crypto positions were liquidated over 24 hours, depending on the snapshot, with longs making up nearly 89% (KuCoin News; CryptoTicker).

themes.title: ETF outflows continue
themes.summary: U.S. spot bitcoin ETFs had $47.7 million of net outflows on Nov. 12, a sixth straight day, bringing the streak to about $1.49 billion; spot ether ETFs have seen about $696 million of outflows so far in November (KuCoin News).

themes.title: Sentiment at extreme fear
themes.summary: The Crypto Fear and Greed Index fell to 20, its lowest since July 8, and average perpetual futures funding rates turned negative for the first time in a month (KuCoin News).

categories.name: Majors (BTC/ETH)
categories.note: Bitcoin was down about 4.7% and Ether about 3% over 24 hours by Friday morning, after deeper overnight losses of 6% to 7% (Yahoo Finance; KuCoin News; FinFly, citing CoinGecko).

categories.name: Large-cap altcoins
categories.note: BNB fell 6.52% to about $631, Solana 5.63% to about $78.24 and XRP 3.74% to about $1 over 24 hours (FinFly, citing CoinGecko).

categories.name: Ether staking
categories.note: About 44.6 million ETH, or 36.51% of supply, is staked, and the validator exit queue holds about 270,000 ETH with a wait of about five and a half days (KuCoin News).

categories.name: Crypto stocks
categories.note: Coinbase, Robinhood and Circle shares declined Friday along with the drop in bitcoin (Yahoo Finance).

watch_list.why: October producer prices rose 0.3%, slightly below forecasts, but the 6.5% annual gain was the largest since 2022, keeping a December Fed hike in focus (KuCoin News; TheStreet).
Bitcoin is trading near its 200-week moving average around $68,000, a level analysts are watching after the overnight break below it (KuCoin News).

Order-book depth was about 33% below normal earlier this week while leverage stays elevated, which Talos said leaves the market open to sharp moves either way; ETF flows are being watched for a turn (KuCoin News).
